hero.intro: Full Stack Developer with 20 years of experience designing and building scalable, high-performance web and mobile applications using .NET Core, Node.js, and modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Angular). Strong expertise in AWS & Azure, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), and containerized deployments. Passionate about clean code, data-driven architecture, and agile collaboration. In the last year I've adopted IA agents tools to boost my productivity as engineer and improve the quality of what I deliver.

Fuerte experiencia en AWS y Azure, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) y despliegues en contenedores. Apasionado por código limpio, arquitectura orientada a datos y colaboración ágil. En el último año he adoptado herramientas de agentes IA para impulsar mi productividad como ingeniero y mejorar la calidad de lo que entrego.
